# Goto

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Functions](Language-Features-Functions)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Goto label
```

## Description

Continues at the line after `.label`. The label has to be in the same function (or in the main program, when `Goto` is in the main program).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 0
.again
n = n + 1
If n < 3 Then Goto again
Print n
```

```text
3
```
